en: The postcard features a sepia-toned image of a large Orthodox cathedral with prominent domes crowned with crosses, set in an urban landscape surrounded by historical buildings. Text framing the bottom of the front side provides context in Bulgarian, French, and transliterated English, identifying the location and landmark. The reverse features handwritten text in Bulgarian, an old Bulgarian postage stamp, and postal markings indicative of authentic correspondence.
